description:
Symbolic and automatic differentiation for C++23 over a runtime
expression graph. Native x64 package: headers plus ddx.dll/ddx.lib in Release
and Debug, with the Boost header subset the public headers reach bundled in
(Boost Software License, same as ddx). Consumers compile with /std:c++latest;
the binaries require AVX2. The LLVM JIT backend is not part of the Windows
build — expressions are interpreted, as ddx.has_jit reports in the Python
wheels.
